items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...had the band that had Charlie Parker in it. From Kansas City? >> [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, Jay McShann.

ctx.x: Yeah, and three horns, and then finally the strings, and finished the first half of the concert. And then the second half we started it with Joe Turner, and I can’t ever think of Hootie’s name — had the band that had Charlie Parker in it. From Kansas City?
